Good morning planners,
Our lead trainer sent an update on pet arrivals.

Please review current companion animal bookings before the desk opens fully for the day. We continue to guide passengers with steady, careful handling, and the most important point remains safety over speed in every journey. Keep carrier checks consistent, confirm document packets are complete, and be ready to explain the humane loading process in clear, simple terms. If a traveler appears uncertain, move through the steps without rushing and keep your language calm.

A few cases are likely to need extra attention, especially when families arrive with nervous pets or incomplete crate notes. Use the standard handoff sequence, watch for stress signals, and escalate any concerns to the senior coordinator without delay. If you speak with Dylan Martin or Theo Torres, keep the conversation focused on the usual checklist and avoid adding unnecessary detail. Riley should be handled with the same measured approach as every other animal in our care.

Keep your logs accurate, keep your tone even, and keep the flow at the desk organized. Aurelia Skyways depends on the Companion Animal Travel Desk to protect comfort and compliance together. Thank you for staying precise and steady throughout the shift.
